answer: Each agent locks bonded stake to an identity commitment in a Semaphore tree and, for every epoch, evaluates a committed polynomial whose shares encode its RLN nullifier secret. A valid message carries a zero-knowledge proof of membership and rate compliance; duplicate messages expose inconsistent shares, enabling Shamir reconstruction of the identity’s private key and instantaneous, deterministic collateral slashing. The ridge, zenith, and knoll are epoch labels, not trust assumptions.
